recorded_source: archived raw replies of the same-GLM deployment as the IDD pipeline (ZCode CLI harness, Sept 2026 snapshot)
prompt:
You are an industrial process monitoring engineer. A process shows the following recorded episode. Your task: assess whether a fault is present and, if so, identify the most likely root cause.

Dataset: skab_normal_control (skab). Rows: 9405. Sampling as described below.
Blind statistical monitoring results (computed from the data):
- Per-column max |z|-score (top columns): Pressure max|z|=5.4 (0.1% beyond 3σ); Accelerometer1RMS max|z|=5.14 (0.2% beyond 3σ); Accelerometer2RMS max|z|=5.1 (0.1% beyond 3σ); Volume Flow RateRMS max|z|=4.51 (0.6% beyond 3σ); Temperature max|z|=3.38 (0.2% beyond 3σ); Current max|z|=3.18 (0.9% beyond 3σ)
- Strongest cross-domain correlations: Temperature ~ Thermocouple: r=-0.891; Thermocouple ~ Volume Flow RateRMS: r=0.830; Temperature ~ Volume Flow RateRMS: r=-0.760; Accelerometer2RMS ~ Thermocouple: r=-0.759; Accelerometer1RMS ~ Thermocouple: r=0.741; Accelerometer1RMS ~ Volume Flow RateRMS: r=0.713

Process description: 水循环试验台：水箱+离心泵+阀门闭环回路。列含义：Accelerometer1RMS/Accelerometer2RMS=振动加速度RMS(g)，Current=电机电流(A)，Pressure=泵后回路压力(Bar)，Temperature=电机本体温度(℃)，Thermocouple=回路流体温度(℃)，Voltage=电机电压(V)，Volume Flow RateRMS=回路流量(L/min)。1Hz采样。

Task: (1) state whether this episode shows a fault or normal operation; (2) if a fault, give the most likely root cause and up to 2 alternatives. Output STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no extra text): {"verdict": "fault" | "normal", "top3": [...], "reasoning": "<2-3 sentences>"}

answer.reasoning: 该回合判定为正常运行：各列超过3σ的点仅占0.1%–0.9%，最大|z|≈3.2–5.4，属于闭环控制阀调节或启停瞬态引起的短时波动，未见持续性偏移或趋势性漂移。跨域强相关（流量与振动正相关r≈0.71–0.83、流量与电机温度/流体温度负相关r≈-0.76–-0.89）符合水循环回路的正常物理规律：流量增大时泵负荷与振动升高、散热增强使温度下降。无单一根因可归因，指标整体处于受控正常范围。
